strengths: The background texture matches a dark, subterranean archive/ruined environment.
The three-hero formation is clearly visible as colored circles in a triangular layout.
weaknesses: Extremely minimal UI that fails to show the shared stats, level progress bar, or skill slots as described in the visual concept plan.
The heroes are represented by generic colored circles rather than stylized fantasy characters or custom sprites.
The health bar is a simple flat red rectangle with no styling or text labels.

strengths: The background features a more distinct rocky cavern/subterranean path texture.
The three-hero formation is clearly centered and visible.
weaknesses: Extremely minimal UI lacking the required shared stats, level progress bar, or skill slots.
Uses generic colored circles for heroes instead of the chiseled stone-textured avatars described in the concept plan.
The health bar is a simple flat red rectangle with no styling or text labels.

selection.rationale: Both V1 and V2 are extremely minimal implementations that rely on placeholder colored circles for the heroes and a basic flat red bar for health, failing to deliver the rich UI elements described in their respective design concepts. However, V2 is selected because its background texture of a rocky subterranean cavern is slightly more distinct and better aligned with the 'subterranean archive' theme than the muddy, dark background of V1.
